bootstrapToken.description:
Optional bootstrap token for first-owner creation.

When the server is configured with `AEGAEON_MANAGEMENT_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN`, this field becomes
required and MUST match that value.

expiresInDays.description: Expiration in days from now. If omitted, the control-plane policy default is used.

neverExpires.description: Explicitly request a non-expiring key. Rejected unless the control-plane policy allows it.

apiKeyValue.description: The raw API key value. Only returned at creation time; cannot be retrieved again.

algorithm.description:
Usage-bound algorithm: RS256 for OIDC signing, RSA-OAEP+A256GCM for OIDC
request-object decryption, and EdDSA for OAuth JWT signing.

usage.description:
Runtime key usage, such as OIDC_ID_TOKEN_SIGNING, JWT_ACCESS_TOKEN_SIGNING,
or JWT_INTROSPECTION_SIGNING.

ErrorResponse.description: Error envelope for management APIs. Common `errorCode` values include `invalid_request`, `not_found`, `forbidden`, `base_version_mismatch`, and `SECURITY_LEDGER_CONFLICT`.

token.description: DCR bearer token; the server trims surrounding whitespace and requires at least 32 bytes of secret material.

managementBearerApiKey.description: Team-scoped management API key. Requests using this scheme must not send management cookies.

managementCsrfHeader.name: X-CSRF-Token
managementCsrfHeader.description: Double-submit CSRF token required for cookie-authenticated state-changing management requests.

tags.description: Runtime key inventory for shared OIDC and token cryptography
